cases.title: Guest cannot open Tasks
preconditions: Use the campaign PLAN.md resource/build receipt. For member/admin choose a device organization and record membership; for guest use a genuinely signed-out profile. Use campaign-owned controlled records.
steps: In guest mode, inspect the tab strip and attempt to navigate to Tasks through any supported tab state restoration path.
expected: Tasks tab is absent and guest cannot render protected task queue.

cases.title: Queue search, project, grouping and sorting
preconditions: Use the campaign PLAN.md resource/build receipt. For member/admin choose a device organization and record membership; for guest use a genuinely signed-out profile. Use campaign-owned controlled records.
steps: As a signed-in member with a selected organization and at least two controlled queue rows, enter a distinctive search term; clear it. Select a project, switch grouping twice, and select another sort option. Reload Tasks.
expected: Search narrows and clear restores matching rows; project/group/sort selections affect visible ordering/grouping and remain consistent after reload.

cases.title: Nested queue filters and reset
preconditions: Use the campaign PLAN.md resource/build receipt. For member/admin choose a device organization and record membership; for guest use a genuinely signed-out profile. Use campaign-owned controlled records.
steps: Open Filters. Select one available domain, status, category, and capture bucket in turn and record row counts; clear all filters. Repeat with an empty facet dataset.
expected: Each selection updates results/count; conditional facets appear only when source data supports them; clear restores unfiltered queue.

cases.title: Row selection and bulk action menu
preconditions: Use the campaign PLAN.md resource/build receipt. For member/admin choose a device organization and record membership; for guest use a genuinely signed-out profile. Use campaign-owned controlled records.
steps: Select one auto-capturable row and one paste-only row. Open bulk resolve and choose each verdict against separate campaign-owned rows; exercise capture with mixed eligibility, then clear selection.
expected: Selection counts match selected rows; bulk capture only processes eligible sources and reports progress; each verdict updates only selected rows; clear removes selection.

cases.title: Single source open, capture, enrich, and verdict
preconditions: Use the campaign PLAN.md resource/build receipt. For member/admin choose a device organization and record membership; for guest use a genuinely signed-out profile. Use campaign-owned controlled records.
steps: Open a controlled source URL and verify it opens separately. Run a normal capture; run a configured enrichment row; exercise awaiting_user Go on a gated fixture. For other rows open Resolve and choose each available verdict, including Retry only after an attempt. Copy URL.
expected: Open acts on the source URL; Run/Enrich starts the matching action; Go resumes user-held capture; each verdict updates that source and Retry visibility follows attempted-level state; copied URL matches row URL.

cases.title: Paste-only source submission
preconditions: Use the campaign PLAN.md resource/build receipt. For member/admin choose a device organization and record membership; for guest use a genuinely signed-out profile. Use campaign-owned controlled records.
steps: Select a paste-only/L4 controlled queue row, enter unique non-secret text in its paste editor, submit, then refresh queue.
expected: Submitted content is acknowledged and associated with that source; refresh shows the resulting status or explicit actionable error.

cases.title: Parallel run session inspection and dismissal
preconditions: Use the campaign PLAN.md resource/build receipt. For member/admin choose a device organization and record membership; for guest use a genuinely signed-out profile. Use campaign-owned controlled records.
steps: Create or observe a controlled parallel run. Expand a sub-run with output, one with an error, and one empty result; collapse and reopen the session; dismiss only after completion.
expected: Expanded rows show URL/output/error/data events as available; empty/running state is explicit; collapse preserves session; unfinished session cannot be mistaken for completed dismissal.

readiness_gaps: No runtime behavior verdict from source reading; execute role, organization, permission, error and persistence cases in the live side panel.
